title: Radiomics and VGG19 fusion model separates dual-phenotype hepatocellular carcinoma on MRI
summary: In 381 patients from four centres (138 HCC, 122 dual-phenotype HCC, 121 intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma), radiomics, deep transfer learning and fusion models were built on contrast-enhanced MRI (244 training, 62 internal test, 75 external test). The VGG19-based fusion model reached a macro-AUC of 0.990 in the internal test set and 0.988 (95% CI 0.964 to 1.000) in the external set, with accuracy 0.875 and F1 0.885 externally. The study is retrospective and the external set is small.
ai_technology: VGG19 deep transfer learning fused with radiomics on contrast-enhanced MRI
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Soochow University

evidence.tested: External test set from two further centres (n=75): macro-AUC 0.988.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective; modest external sample; clinical impact untested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A pretrained VGG19 network and radiomic features were fused to classify three liver tumour types.
